Select IC50 activity records against the human single-protein target Histone deacetylase 6 (CHEMBL1865) with compound structures and publication references.

Filter:
- target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1865'
- activities.standard_type = 'IC50'
- compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
- docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL

Join path (use indexed assay_id path):
- activities → assays on assay_id
- assays → target_dictionary on tid
- activities → compound_records on record_id
- compound_records → molecule_dictionary on molregno
- molecule_dictionary → compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN, structures required)
- activities → docs on doc_id

Return columns:
- molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id
- compound_structures.canonical_smiles
- compound_records.compound_key
- COALESCE(CAST(docs.pubmed_id AS TEXT), docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
- assays.description AS assay_description
- activities.standard_type
- activities.standard_relation
- activities.standard_value
- activities.standard_units
- activities.activity_comment
- target_dictionary.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id
- target_dictionary.pref_name AS target_name
- target_dictionary.organism AS target_organism

Do not deduplicate — preserve every qualifying activity row.
Order by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
